notes: Customer profile: mid-market SaaS building an in-app product analytics assistant (support + guided product tour). heavy chat + doc search mix.
Initial ask: start on Hosted API to validate quality, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

POC requirements (from SE call):
- Traffic pattern: bursts (3x daily), steady baseline ~60 req/s, spikes to 250 req/s for short periods.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for short responses (<= 300 tokens).
- Throughput target during POC: sustain 120 req/s with <2% CPU throttling events.
- Cost sensitivity: want quantized 13B option if quality delta vs 70B < 6% on eval prompts.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: infra prep + VPC peering + KMS test keys
- Week 1: baseline on Hosted API w/ sample workload; capture token distribution and latency histograms
- Week 2: bring up Dedicated cluster (13B quantized) behind canary router (5% traffic)
- Week 3: scale canary to 25% and run region failover test (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1) during maintenance window
- Week 4: run rollback scenarios (inject latency/errors) and run final quality evals vs hosted model. deliver perf + cost report

Canary & fallback routing details (from call):
- Canary policy: header-based + percentage split; start 5% -> metric gates (error rate, latency) -> expand to 25% if gates pass
- Metric gates: error rate < 1.5%, p95 latency increase < 20% vs baseline, quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim) within threshold
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to Hosted API model variant in same region when Dedicated variant exceeds gates; secondary fallback = region failover to EU cluster for sessions pinned to EU residency
Rollback criteria: continuous error rate > 2% for 10 minutes OR average latency p95 > 500ms for 5 minutes -> auto-rollback and alert; SE to run manual rollback test during POC week 3.
Model preferences: prefer OSS family (Llama 2 13B quantized for cost path, 70B for quality check). want Redwood-verified perf numbers. Ensure tokenizer args and stop sequences match existing prompts.
Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 12 months, KMS integration mandatory (customer-managed keys preferred), need data residency assurance for EU customers.
